valid_period_expired.meaning: the UserOperation's validity period (validAfter/validUntil window) is expired at execution time

operation_executed_outside_period.meaning: the UserOperation is executed outside its intended validity period as a result of unenforced validUntil/validAfter constraints

assumptions: EntryPoint relies on validationData returned by AtomWallet's _validateSignature to gate execution timing (assume_entrypoint_trusts_return).
The owner signed the UserOperation and it was submitted through a Bundler/EntryPoint flow (pre_owner_signs, pre_bundler_submits).

unresolved.description: Report does not state who may modify validUntil/validAfter or whether the modification is permissionless; the temporal relation is still expressible, so this is a nonblocking clarification.
No concrete timestamp/block is provided for an actual out-of-period execution; a symbolic validity-window state is used instead.

limitations: Only the temporal_validity relation is formalized; the direct bypass impact 'impact_time_validation_bypassed' is deferred to a future claim.
Root cause 'rc_excluded_from_hash' (period fields excluded from signature hash) is not part of this selected relation and is not asserted as P.
Whether a prior valid signature over the original period existed before manipulation is not established.
Concrete validAfter/validUntil values and execution timestamps are symbolic-only.
